# AppSync GraphQL reference fixtures

Generated by `tools/reference/generate-appsync-graphql.mjs` using the installed
Powertools TypeScript v2.35.0 public AppSync GraphQL exports. Scenarios compare
ordered diagnostics, handler calls, return values and propagated errors. Top-level
JavaScript undefined is recorded as JSON null; this is an explicit Go mapping.
Scalar fixtures replace the JavaScript clock, preserving the actual upstream
formatters. UUID generation is checked structurally in Go rather than normalized
into an equality assertion. No AWS service behavior is established by fixtures.
